policy: Exact, issue-linked exceptions to the CI axiom audit (QBP #827; director ruling, option (a)). Each entry names ONE fully qualified declaration and the EXACT extra axiom name(s) it may depend on, plus the open issue that owns it. A declaration is allowed only if its non-standard axioms EQUAL the entry's; any other non-standard axiom fails the gate; an entry whose declaration no longer reports exactly these axioms is STALE and fails the gate, so the entry must be deleted when its issue lands. No wildcards, prefixes or per-file entries. A Lean toolchain bump that renumbers the native axiom (`ax_1_1`) makes the entry stale on purpose: re-check it, do not widen it.
